name: scarf
description: A wrapped scarf with a broad neck band and two separate hanging ends.
useCase: Identify scarves or neckwear in a clothing catalogue.
misuse: Use a visible label when clothing identifies a product, size or dress requirement.

16.reason: The wide neck band joins two broad scarf ends with a clear gap between them.

24.reason: The larger scarf keeps two full separate ends beneath its broad wrapped band.
